cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4M_Suspension_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

R4M_Suspension_Tower.role: static tower bracket with arm pivot lugs, damper ear, bump stop

R4M_Suspension_Arm.role: trailing arm: rotates about local X at the pivot; +14 deg = bump (hub up), -10 deg = droop

R4M_Suspension_ShockBody.role: damper body: rotates about local X at the upper eye, follows the rod

R4M_Suspension_ShockRod.role: damper rod: positioned at the arm's lower eye, slides into the body

R4M_Suspension_Spring.role: coil rings (child of body): local Z scale = spring length ratio

Wheel_Axle.role: wheel mounting face on the stub axle, local +Z = file +X

notes: Damper body/rod/spring follow the arm analytically each frame (no constraints needed in Unity).
